svg.text: SECTION G-G THROUGH THE STACK HOLE (4:1)
HOLE TABLE AON-103 (frame -Z face at satellite Z = 6.50 [.256])
1. Datums: A = +X bar outer face, B = -Y bar outer face, C = the -Z face. All features ⌖ Ø0.1 A B C unless noted.
2. Bar end faces (Y ±41.5, X ±41.5) are the rail seats: overall 83.00 +0/-0.05 [3.2677 +0/-.002] so the rails pull in to a 100.0 ±0.1 envelope. Square to A/B
3. Thickness 10.00 ±0.05; both Z faces flat 0.05 and parallel 0.05 (they set the board stack length).
4. Taps: form-tap or cut, class 6H; blow out chips; check with go/no-go gauges; no helicoils needed (assembly torques on AON-002 are below the 6061 strip
5. Inside corners: R0.5 max tool radius at the block/bar junctions; the relief square at each outer corner (1.5 x 1.5) clears the rail edge radius.
6. Chromate-free conversion coat all over after machining (bonding path rail-frame-panel ground < 10 mΩ, AON-900 T11). No anodise on frames.
7. All materials on NASA outgassing list: TML < 1.0 %, CVCM < 0.10 % (ASTM E595). No cadmium, zinc or tin plating (whiskers).
